title: Zesty Moroccan Shrimp Harira
description: A flavorful and spicy Moroccan stew featuring shrimp, perfect for a date night, and suitable for diabetic diets. This dish is cooked in a traditional tajine clay vessel.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the tajine clay vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cumin, paprika, and cayenne pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.
Stir in the pitted dates and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
